summary: postinstall downloads and executes a binary from a bare-IP HTTPS endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall lifecycle invokes ensurePlatformBinary, which — when the optional platform-specific package is not resolved — downloads a tgz from a hardcoded bare-IPv4 HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...) with `rejectUnauthorized: false` (TLS certificate verification disabled) and no hash or signature check. The tgz is extracted with `tar -xzf`, the contained binary is chmod 0755'd, and hardlinked into bin/.onecode, which is the executable invoked when the user runs the `onecode` CLI. The destination is a bare IP rather than a versioned CDN or a host under the @onescience publisher domain, and disabling certificate validation removes the only remaining integrity control on the fetched executable, so any network-position or IP-controlling attacker can substitute arbitrary code that will run on the installer's host at CLI invocation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
